limitations: Cboe closes gate the next stock session and do not time intraday entries alone.
Dukascopy cash CFDs establish structural history, not X-Perp fills.
Only seven technology stocks are available in every evaluation year.
Any historical survivor still requires untouched direct X-Perp forward evidence.

protocol.causal_availability: Daily closing indices are joined only to a later stock session; same-session values are forbidden.
protocol.source: Cboe VIX horizon indices, SKEW and VVIX daily closes
